title: Review app shell implementation
description: Review all changes introduced by spec-b15d4b1a: new Swift source files, modified app entry point, deleted ContentView, updated tests, and doc additions. Verify every acceptance criterion from the spec is satisfied, code style is idiomatic SwiftUI, no out-of-scope functionality was added, NavigationStack and sheet presentation follow SwiftUI best practices, and tests use the Swift Testing framework correctly.
acceptance_criteria: All spec acceptance criteria are verifiably satisfied by the implementation
TabView tab order, SF Symbols, and subtitles match the spec exactly
Settings sheet uses ToolbarItemPlacement.confirmationAction for Done
RecipesTab gear icon correctly triggers sheet presentation via @State
EmptyStateView is reused consistently across all three tabs
Tests use import Testing / @Test / #expect with no XCTest imports
No out-of-scope code is present (UIDocumentPicker, CookLang, real settings, meal plan/shopping list logic)
ContentView.swift is fully removed with no dangling references
Architecture doc additions are accurate and non-contradictory
